nom: Pixi DetoxifEYE Depuffing Eye Patches with Caffeine & Cucumber

avis.titre: Good patch, but slips off easily
avis.texte: I do believe they help with puffiness. I just dislike how the patches slip off so easily but I would buy them again. Also make sure to keep them in the fridge!

I've read a few of the comments, and when people say they all face the same direction really has me scratching my head. Since they are layered in the jar and they are all perfectly coated with amazing good stuff, just don't take from the top, every now and then flip in the jar. Sometimes I wear them overnight and it's magic in the morning and other times I wear them for a few hours before getting ready and again they're magic.

avis.titre: i would not buy these again
avis.texte: i do not recommend this for sensitive or young skin because it made my undereyes irritated and red and as soon as i put them on it started burning really bad right away so i do not recommend
These felt good, but as other comments state, both patches are the same "side" so you only get serum on one side. Makes them pointless.

I do like the coolness of these patches and it has a lot of the product in. But I was pregnant using these and I still had puffyness around the eyes. So I think I did my own research and realized it isn't very effective LOL :D
I like the coolness of this product. But I can't tell the difference if it does its job as I'm currently pregnant and my eyes are still puffy :/

I received a sample in a gap. It did a great job de-puffing my eye bags. The manufacturing seemed a little odd since each "side" faces the same direction, so you end up with only one smooth/serum side on the skin. I would consider purchasing these as they seem to work well for puffy eyes.

avis.titre: Incredibly effective for under eye fluid retention
avis.texte: Inmediately reduces the visibilty of fluid retention in my under eye area. They slide a bit (I believe due to shape), but pretty effective before I apply my makeup, after I've had a drink or two, or after a rough night of sleep. Would not say they reduce the appearance of dark circles as much as they reduce puffiness around the area. Would purchase again!
Honestly these were so weird, thought maybe I got a bad batch. They look nothing like advertised and would not fit my undereye at all. Kept slipping off. Horrible…

avis.titre: who doesn't love eye gel pads 😍
avis.texte: Bought the 5 pack for a friend's birthday giftbag. She loved them and bought more after running out :)

The patches were cooling but they both face the same direction so you cant have the serum side facing towards your skin on both sides. Its a really odd and obvoous error. Im surprised they haven't fixed it by now. I bought a 5 pack and thought maybe one packet had an error but it was all of thrm.

avis.titre: Too big and continuously slides off
avis.texte: I believe these were made with the face of a giant in mind: the patches are huge and weirdly shaped. They are either in my tear ducts or on my cheeks (they do not stay in place!).

I was underwhelmed by this product, mainly because the eye patches face the wrong direction so you aren't able to apply them in the opposing directions. You have to flip one on the other side where the product isn't on, that's just a structural error. Also, the patches themselves are just okay, while they're cooling, they don't last very long and end up leaving an imprint on your face if they stay on more than like 10 minutes.
Statred to burn my under eye area immediately. I would not recommend.

avis.titre: i would not buy this product again.
avis.texte: The patches did not de-puff my eye bags at all. Also, I could keep them from sliding down on my face. I had to late flat to keep them on my face. Who has time to lay flat for 15 minutes every day for a single product.

I received a sample of these free as a gift with purchase. They were a little awkward to apply due to the shape but I applied them. Within 3 minutes, I started to feel my skin tingling/stinging. I thought maybe it was supposed to feel that way, but by 5 minutes, it was burning. I took them off and rinsed immediately. I had red marks in the shape of the patches under my eyes. I was able to cool them with some Aquaphor but these are definitely not meant for sensitive skin.

avis.titre: I have used regularly with great success
avis.texte: I refrigerate these eye patches and use them in the mornings. They are wonderfully refreshing and leave my skin feeling smooth and perfect under the eye. I also use the occasional patch on an area of my cheek where I see noticeable fine lines. Those lines are all but gone when I'm done. I leave them on for an hour or so when I can. Definitely buying again.

avis.titre: tried to like it but my eyes dont
avis.texte: this product is effective and will depuff eyes... but it will have effects of itchiness, green stain after drying under eyes, too much liquid that it drops off my face sometimes, I would expect better for paying over 20 dollars for an item. such a shame
They didnt stay under the eye. Way too slippery and kept sliding down.
I wasn't expecting this product to work so well. Highly recommend keeping it in the fridge; it makes application so much easier.

I put these on mornings my eyes are puffy. I can tell a difference in the before and after. These eye patches have a cooling effect that is nice. Puffiness and redness improves after 5+ minutes. This is an item I will keep on hand from now on.

First off I love that they have 24k in them ✨ I use these eye gels every morning and they make everyday gorg & luxurious 💕 I dont store them in the fridge but they always still give me that cooling effect ❄️ I love theseeeee 🥰
I got this not too long ago and it reduces puffiness. It didn't really fit my under eye and I had to adjust it often.
These are the best eye patches. I have tried others but these are the best and I can feel them as they work. I recommend these to others. Helps with eye puffiness and dark spots.
This is a GREAT product! Noticeable improvement in a couple days! I store it in the fridge & apply as directed. It my "Me time!" SO relaxing & soothing! Will definitely purchase again & again!
I loved this product I was scared. I was gonna whenever I put it on, but it didn't. There are so. refreshing to put on in the morning and afternoon. I would recommend this product.

These patches are absolutely necessary for when you've had a good (or a bad) cry. I use them anytime my eyes are puffy, usually after a cry session.

I have out of nowhere been experiencing puffiness under my eyes occasionally and it is so ANNOYING. This is the first product I've tried that's actually brought instant relief and significant reduction in puffiness. I am SO HAPPY with this product 💚💚
This stuff is the best. My eye bags were completely gone by the 2nd usage.

So I finally decided to order these recently. I was skeptic and searching for a product to fit all my needs. I look tired some days and have bags under my eyes. This brand mixed all the ingredients I had been hearing helps with these issues and dark circles. So soon as I got them I read instructions and decided to refrigerate them for a couple of mins for my first try. They are so juicy :D in a good way and gives you the feel of cucumbers on your eyes. These can be placed anywhere I also read. I will wear these for a week and see if I can give you all an update, but right now I feel so pampared facially. Pixi you did not disappoint. I been hooked on lipgloss here now its eye care, thanks! Oh and these do not have ot be refrigerated, just keep them cool.
The combo of ingredients in these are so anazong! My face literally changes aftee using them. Looks so refreshed and glowing!

avis.titre: I got my man using them daily before work

They do make a difference with depuffying the eyes we love them!

avis.titre: I would buy it again and again
avis.texte: I really wish we had one of these stores in Canada or at least where allowed to order online from you.

These have become a daily ritual! I alternate between these and the Fortifye. I'm fortunate not to have dark under eye circles but can use a little help sometimes in the morning. These are a perfect pick me up for tired eyes. And I do think they are smoothing the skin . Definitely keep them in the fridge for extra benefits.
These patches are pure magic, they work wonders my puffiness and dark circles. My eyes are instantly refreshed and bright.

I had my eye on these for a while before purchasing. I have developed pretty dark circles under my eyes and was intrigued by the caffeine. I finally decided to try them and I do like them. I might be using them backwards, but I prefer the thicker part under my eyes to get more coverage. They are cooling and refreshing. They have stung a couple of times but it wasn't anything unbearable and I think my skin was just dry or being sensitive those times. I have noticed a difference in my dark circles and that's what I was hoping for. They appear brighter and I look more refreshed. The one bad thing I will say is that mine developed a terrible smell after a couple of weeks of being opened. I always wash my hands before using them and use the wand that comes with them to get them out. This sounds disgusting, but I would deacribe the smell as similar to poop. I feel like the smell has gotten stronger the longer they've been opened. Would like to repurchase because they work for me, but the smell is offensive.
I have been using these for the last 5 years and actually keep one in the refrigerator for those 'hot flash' moments. 😊

I have used many different eye patches and these seem to work the best. You can't beat the price, and the delivery is fast. Make sure you get the detoxify eye patches they have caffeine in them which makes all the difference.

Ive never had an allergic reaction to any skincare product so im really not sure why these patches turned my under eyes bright red! They burned so bad, it felt like it burned my under eyes. Within a minute after putting the patches my skin was bright red and burning. This has never happened! i have even used these exact patches before and never had a problem, i opened a new package i was gifted and it completley burned my face!

These are definitely my favorite eye patches that I have ever owned. They are so soothing and moisturizing they make me feel like I never want to take them off. They feel so good on my skin and they smell so awesome! If you want good eye masks buy these!

Bought my first under eye patches from the Beverly Hills Pixy store. It's my first time using them and the caffeine does work on them. I'm 36, I work from home, mother of two tweens, at night I like to stay up late to watch some TV to put myself to sleep so I can assure you I have puffy eyes and dark circles. So far I love the tingle I get during the 10 minute treatment. I don't expect the dark circles to go away I have accepted I am an official racoon. Recommendation, thicker part goes out and the thinner part goes in. I did it the other way around. -thebasiclife_ Follow me on TT for visuals.

Absolutely love these patches! If you do the math and use them daily, its a far better price than buying those individually wrapped ones. They do sting a little when you first start using them or use them directly after washing your face, but you get used to it and I'd say the results are worth it! I get a tired feeling in my undereyes and I have always had puffy/dark circles. These immediately helped and continued to fight my chronic darck circles even when I stopped use for a bit. My only complaint is that it starts to smell different if you keep the product for more than a couple months. I dont think its gone bad as I have no negative skin reaction, and the container says it's supposed to last for 6 months after opening. But it smells odd enough to make me throw the last 10 sets of patches away. So sad. Thats the only reason I gave this product 4 stars. Next time I buy this, I'll make sure to use the whole container in 2 months or less.
Why is there titanium dioxide in this product? I'm confused by the ingredients list, isn't this supposed to be a conscious beauty brand?

avis.titre: The best eyes patches I've tried!
avis.texte: Great product! Love them and the way and freshness of it! I don't have under bags in my eyes within 15 minutes! Love love love them!

I've tried handfuls of different eye patch brands, and this one is the best so far! The quality and price can't be matched. They work better than many other high-end name brands and you can use them daily for the price, and see benefits right away. This is a new staple in my beauty regime - use them every morning.

avis.titre: I like this very much for the price point

I think it was all the fruit extracts that irritated my skin. Oh well. It looks like it works for other people , so thats good.

I love these eye masks, they help reduce the overall puffiness of my under eyes! I use them the morning of special occasions and they work wonders!! Just keep them on while getting ready and you're good to go

My skin is not sensitive with products and I purchase different undereye patches. However, with this product I noticed that it irritated my skin and it burned as well. It hurt to have under my eyes after a minute. Would not repurchase.
I never make reviews but THIS IS THE BOMB 😭😭😭 didn't expect it to take away dark bags or puffiness i was just planning on using it for rejuvenation but it did everything!!

avis.titre: Love these to freshen under eyes

amazing so cooling and u can really feel the caffine doing its job

I use the patches every evening after cleansing. It helps sooth the eye area. I have dark under eye circles and use concealer. After I remove my makeup and cleanse my face I treat the area with a detoxifeye patch. They are great.

avis.titre: Best eye patches on the market

avis.titre: Really smooths and plumps those wrinkles!

These eye patches are sooo nice! Not only do they feel amazing when they're on they also WORK! i leave these on normally in the morning while i'm lounging or doing tasks around the house. sometimes i use them before bed too. i usually leave them on for an hour or until the dry out. i love these so far and it's only my fourth time using. very refreshing and i have noticed a difference in the brightness of my bags and under eye hollows. i leave mine in the fridge after my first use. i haven't used them before makeup but i don't think mine pill like some people are saying. they also don't slide on me, especially after being on for a minute or two. will definitely repurchase when i run out and probably will try the other kinds.
